topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I opened the box, and there it was—a piece of art, clumsy, uneven, but unmistakably his. It stared back at me, a smear of colors that no gallery would ever hang. I remembered him, the brash one, always on the edge of chaos, thinking the world owed him. This... this was supposed to be a gift, a token of gratitude they say. But why now, after all these years? What right does he have to send me this reminder? I don’t need his apologies or his offerings. I set it down, hard, on the desk, where it doesn’t belong, just like him.
